title: Protocol-Identity Denylist for Normative Property Fields
description: A BPO property record states a behavioural truth over abstract sorts, functions, transition classes, and policy parameters. Concrete protocol identity — an implementation's name, a source revision, a deployment address, a local obligation id, or a fixed policy constant — belongs to a downstream assurance-case crosswalk (schema/assurance-case.schema.json), never to the record itself. This file is the data behind that rule; schema/validate_refs.py enforces it as a build gate so genericity is machine-checked rather than promised in review.
rationale: The gate matters most where there is no case study in-repo to absorb specifics. Without it, the pressure to write down 'the' rounding direction, 'the' health comparator, or 'the' virtual-share offset that a particular study happened to verify is unopposed, and a reusable record silently becomes a description of one deployment. A denied term is not a claim the concept is unimportant — it is a claim the concept is a PARAMETER the record must declare and a specialization must bind.

checked_fields: formalization.* (all subfields, including signature, symbols, first_order_logic, temporal_logic.*, hoare[].*, state_machine, type_theoretic, algebraic, hyperproperty)

excluded_fields.why: Cross-walk and provenance surface by design. External registry ids (CWE/SWC/EIP/ERC) are exactly what belongs here.
Illustrative threat material, explicitly non-normative. BPO:0101 legitimately cites the ERC-4626 vault inflation-attack class here.
Attribution of where an abstraction came from is scholarship, not a semantic commitment. Kept generic by authoring convention rather than by this gate.
Tool names (Certora, Echidna, ProB, Foundry) are not protocol identity. Naming the prover that checks a property does not make the property about one deployment.

denied_terms.note: Phrase-scoped deliberately: bare `compound` is ordinary vocabulary in a lending-accrual record ('compound interest') and denying it would be a false positive.
Phrase-scoped: bare `curve` is ordinary mathematical vocabulary.
Phrase-scoped: bare `euler` is ordinary mathematical vocabulary.
A specific fixed-point scale. A generic record declares a scale parameter; it does not pick 18 decimals.
A specific accrual approximation scheme. BPO:0112 declares an approximation relation as a parameter; selecting a third-order Taylor expansion is a specialization's choice.
A specific virtual-share offset. BPO:0111 declares the offset as a policy parameter.

denied_patterns.note: A 40-hex git revision. Pinning a subject revision is the crosswalk's job.
Local obligation and assumption identifiers from a downstream verification project.

allowlist_policy: An entry here is an admission that a denied token appears legitimately in a normative field. Add one only with a stated reason, and prefer rewriting the field. Narrowing `denied_terms` to make a hit disappear defeats the gate; recording the exception keeps it visible.
